decision: UiState.covers is Signal<u64> (a revision count), not the plan's Signal<CoverMap>; the map lives in the stored model (engine-thread-only) and screens read it through covers helpers

decision: no testing seam invented for the runtime: AppRuntime composes over the suite's existing mock ports field-by-field (the composed_shell twin precedent); the one engine-side stand-in is a command-applier thread standing in for the AudioEngine in the headless probe
why: the real AudioEngine over MockAudioOutput has no consumer backpressure - it drains the scripted track to EOF in ms and TrackEnded parks playback, so Playing is unobservable at a readout; the bridge path (command - session - pump - signal) is unchanged by the substitution

result: 6 bridge tests green over mock ports; noted for the parent

decision: pump change detection: per-tick CheapSnapshot compares state, position rounded to 1/10 s, duration/volume by bits, muted, shuffle, repeat, queue len/index, and the current track id STRING COMPARED WITHOUT CLONING; full PlaybackView rebuilt only when moved, with current/up_next Arcs reused from the last view when the playing identity is unchanged
why: the spike cloned the whole 50k queue every tick (15.65% idle median); the tick must not clone the queue (task requirement)
result: idle median 0.00% of one core over 73 samples with the 50k queue parked and playback stopped (docs/execution-plans/evidence/nsh/n3/logs/n3-idle.csv)

decision: never cloned in the tick: the PlaybackQueue (sync_playback takes a reference), the up_next window (only the 8-row limit materializes on identity moves), the notices history (ring of 50, snapshot only when new notices drained), the settings snapshot (compare-then-rebuild against the last one), the sidebar reads (event-gated on LibraryChanged); covers poll drains the worker's queue

decision: playlist_revision bumps via Arc::ptr_eq on the projection's cached playlists Arc; library_revision carries the BackendEvent LibraryChanged generation

result: headless test library_and_playlist_revisions_move_with_their_generations green
